title: The Spider Who Couldn't Break the Chain - Kurapika Buries Uvogin

cuts.raw_narration: In a remote rocky wasteland at night, Uvogin, a huge muscular Phantom Troupe member in a fur-collared coat, stands facing Kurapika, a blond young man in a blue tabard with chains dangling from his fingers. Uvogin, calm and confident, tells Kurapika to pick where he wants to die. Kurapika answers flatly that he prefers somewhere remote, so Uvogin's screams will not bother anyone, his side profile hardening with resolve as the two square off alone in the gorge.

Before the fight starts, Kurapika stops Uvogin with a question. A brief flash of scarlet eyes against a blood-red field underlines the memory as Kurapika asks whether Uvogin remembers the people he has killed. Uvogin smirks and shrugs that he only recalls the ones who left an impression. Kurapika names the Kurta clan of the Lukso province, the small clan with scarlet-colored eyes slaughtered five years ago. Uvogin first pretends the name means nothing, then admits he was definitely in the Troupe back then. Kurapika, eyes narrowing, demands to know what goes through his mind when he kills innocent people. Uvogin answers with total indifference: nothing, not a thing. Kurapika's face hardens, his fist wrapped in Nen chains, and he condemns Uvogin as scum who will pay with his life.

Mid-fight, after a smokescreen exchange, Kurapika calmly reveals his trick: the chains have been conjured from Nen all along, which means he can use In to render them invisible, and he only let them hang in plain sight so his enemies would assume he was a manipulator controlling real chains. The camera cuts to Uvogin suddenly looking down as glowing chains snap taut around his massive torso, cinching tight across his arms and chest. Kurapika holds the far end of the chain from a distance, announcing that while Uvogin was busy making empty threats, the chains were already wrapped around his body. Kurapika leaps high against the dark red-moon sky and drops down onto Uvogin, driving him into the ground in a burst of dust, then declares the capture complete as Uvogin kneels, fully bound.

Even chained, Uvogin laughs hysterically and finally remembers: a clan living out in the middle of nowhere whose scarlet eyes the Troupe's boss liked. He grins through the chains and taunts Kurapika, asking if his silly grudge is all he can think about. Kurapika, blood-spattered and cold, answers that he will never break these chains. Then the reveal lands: Kurapika's eyes blaze scarlet in extreme close-up, and an on-screen hexagon diagram of the Nen types appears as red text flashes the name of his specialist ability, Emperor Time. Kurapika explains that when his eyes turn scarlet he can use one hundred percent of every Nen type at once. Uvogin's grin finally falters into a sweaty, worried stare.

With the fight over, Kurapika gives Uvogin his final chance. The Judgment Chain is shown wrapped around Uvogin's exposed beating heart, a bladed little-finger chain with its name glowing on screen, and Kurapika sets the rule: answer every question truthfully, or the chain crushes his heart. He demands the location of the other Spiders. Uvogin, face covered in blood, looks down in silence, then smiles defiantly and spits out his refusal: go to hell, you son of a bitch. A red light flares where the chain enters his chest, and a stark black-and-white sequence shows Uvogin throwing his head back screaming as the chain crushes his heart. Color returns as his lifeless body falls face-first onto the rock. Kurapika's scarlet eyes slowly fade back to blue. He digs a grave in the desolate valley and stands alone beside the finished mound under a glowing red moon, paying silent respects to his buried enemy.
